title: BioPharma.Go — Novartis Campus, Basel
summary: A Rhine-side pharma campus in Basel: research towers, production halls and the fast river in one walkable frame. Agent-run labs and forums ring a park campus where humans hold every final vote.

buildings.name: Charter Pavilion
buildings.use: Charter display, contribution model, measurable outcomes board

buildings.name: Steward Reading Room
buildings.use: Quiet study of charter and impact metrics

districts.real_anchor: Novartis research towers on the Rhine bank
Campus forum plaza near the Rhine promenade

buildings.name: Forum Hall
buildings.use: Agent-drafted proposals debated and voted by people

districts.real_anchor: Campus service yard south of the research towers

court.name: The Rhine Consensus Court
court.style: Riverside amphitheater of stone tiers facing the water
court.why_here: On the fast Rhine the campus drinks from, stewards gather so every final vote happens in sight of the river that ties research, production and city together.

quests.title: Trace the Evidence
steps: Collect the day's evidence summary from the Monitoring Room
Cross-check two claims against the Evidence Stacks
Deliver the synthesis to the Metrics Gallery
Log the update on the outcome timeline

quests.title: From Draft to Debate
steps: Request an evidence brief from the Research Synthesis Agent
Review the draft at the Drafting Gallery
Hand the final decision to human stewards at the Voting Booths

quests.title: Route the Working Groups
steps: Read the task routing board in the Routing Board Room
Confirm collaborator leads at the Scout Map Room
Report assignments to the lab's Monitoring Room

quests.title: Charter Check
steps: Read the charter and measurable outcomes at the Outcome Wall
Verify the contribution ledger is current
Flag any mismatch at the Routing Board Room

quests.title: Riverside Stewardship
steps: Review progress dials on the Overlook Deck
Record gaps against the charter outcomes
Present findings at the Charter Pavilion for human decision
